title: Headed to ASHG 2026? Explore events featuring the CFDE!
bodyHtml:
Knowledge Portal Network at ASHG 2026

Join us at the American Society of Human Genetics annual meeting at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal October 20-23, 2026 for conversations, connections, and new directions in genetics.

Learn more here: akleao.com/portal/cfde-at-ashg-2026

Featured Symposia

Session Information
This session introduces open-access resources for human genetics developed within the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE), an initiative that promotes reuse and integration of data and resources generated by NIH Common Fund programs. Speakers will describe a series of CFDE resources that leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and knowledge graphs to promote data integration from disparate programs, including AI-ready cellular maps, protein-centric annotations, harmonized knowledge graphs, and LLM-assisted genomic exploration tools. The session will show how CFDE resources support integrative and reproducible analyses, and how AI and knowledge graphs can be leveraged more broadly for discovery within human genetics and biomedicine.

Learning Objectives
Describe how AI-driven integration and knowledge graphs in the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) enable cross-connection of disparate resources
Assess how protein annotation, multimodal data harmonization, and gene-trait connections provide mechanistic insight
Apply conceptual approaches from Common Fund Data Ecosystem platforms to integrate multi-source data and enhance your own research

CEU Credits
1.50

Ancillary Sessions

Booth 324

Ecosystem in action! Booth 324 is your lab for the latest scientific updates, explore live tool demonstrations, connect 1:1 with program leaders, and experience DCC Spotlight Hours showcasing innovations across the consortium. Don’t miss your chance to discover, engage, and network with the teams driving the future of data and discovery!

Join us October 21-23rd from 9:30 AM–4:30 PM!
summary: The CFDE will be hosting various events; come stop by to connect with the team, ask scientific questions, and get personalized demonstrations!
